mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and higher costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.2 million units signals strong consumer demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.2 million and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL is rising, and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.
